messages:
julia: Heads-up — spotted a small but consistent regression in the canary of `text-router` this morning. Canary error % up ~0.6pp vs baseline over the last 15m. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/abcd1234/rollouts?panel=heatmap :eyes:

raj: saw that alert. is it concentrated on a single slice or widespread? can you paste the slice heatmap?

julia: attaching quick slice view — looks concentrated on session.region=eu-west and route=/v1/generate (shared link above, filter set). Not all users affected.

elaine: interesting — traffic split was 5% canary for this rollout, correct?

julia: yes 5% (traffic.policy=weighted). Canary instance count is 2 pods.

micah: deploy-bot: can you confirm rollout metadata?

deploy-bot: rollout/tx-text-router v2.3-canary started by @julia at 2026-03-18T09:12Z, traffic=5%, guard=error_rate_delta>1pp OR latency_p95_delta>25% (temporary guard).

raj: the guard config looks a bit coarse. delta >1pp didn't trigger, but we're seeing 0.6pp localized spike. suggests we need slice-aware alerts, not just global.

elaine: agreed. UX question: in the Console rollout view should we show both global delta and top-3 negative slices inline? current view only shows global overlays which hides these small but user-visible regressions.

ux-liz: for rollout UX, showing a "Top slices by regression" bar under the global metric would be quick wins. We can show sample rate, affected requests, and a link to drilldown.

micah: technically we can compute top slices by this PromQL-ish approach in the telemetry pipeline — group_left by slice and compare canary vs baseline. here's a starter prom query for error rate delta per slice:

```promql
(
  sum by (session_region,route) (rate(http_server_errors_total{deployment="text-router",variant="canary"}[5m]))
  /
  sum by (session_region,route) (rate(http_requests_total{deployment="text-router",variant="canary"}[5m]))
)
-
(
  sum by (session_region,route) (rate(http_server_errors_total{deployment="text-router",variant="baseline"}[5m]))
  /
  sum by (session_region,route) (rate(http_requests_total{deployment="text-router",variant="baseline"}[5m]))
)
```

micah: then sort and take top 5 negative deltas. Add a min-reqs threshold to avoid noise (e.g., baseline requests >= 100/min).

raj: +1. Also suggestion: make guards support slice-scoped thresholds. Example rule: block rollout if any slice with >=0.5% absolute error increase AND slice traffic >=0.5% overall. That would catch these cases without blocking harmless noise.

julia: would that require adding per-slice evaluation to the control plane? how expensive is that?

micah: it's extra aggregation but we already emit slice labels in metrics. We can evaluate per-slice in the telemetry service (streaming job) and push computed alerts to the guard engine over the existing API. Perf should be fine for current cardinality (we only evaluate slices listed in rollout config or top N from heatmap).

elaine: for Console, let's add a small indicator next to the global delta: "2 slices failing" that expands to list. Clicking a slice opens the drilldown. We should also expose a toggle: "treat slice-level failures as rollout-blocking" for advanced users.

ux-liz: working on a quick mock — will post later today.

raj: temporary remediation: reduce canary to 2% while we investigate, or rollback if it grows. Thoughts?

julia: i'm leaning reduce to 2% for now. I'll also add a live query to the investigation thread.

micah: ops note: when you change traffic percent, remember autoscaler wont kill pods immediately; ensure LB reconfiguration completes.

julia: reducing now: `rolloutctl set-traffic tx-text-router --percent 2 --variant canary`

deploy-bot: traffic update scheduled: tx-text-router canary -> 2% by @julia at 2026-03-18T09:21Z.

raj: follow-up action items:
- (julia) keep reduced traffic, watch slice deltas for 30m
- (micah) implement slice-aware guard prototype in telemetry (top-N + min-reqs)
- (ux-liz, elaine) Console mock for inline top-slices and toggle
- (raj) propose guard DSL changes (examples for absolute and relative thresholds)

elaine: i'll add design tasks to the rollout board.

micah: I'll post a PR with telemetry query + CI job that'll compute top slices and emit `rollout_slice_delta` metric.

julia: thanks team. will update here if it spikes after the reduction. :thumbsup:
